ios.desc:
FitCrumbs is the ideal app for outdoor activity lovers who prefer simplicity without sacrificing functionality. With FitCrumbs, users can quickly create personalized routes for running, hiking  or any outdoorsy sport and effortlessly follow them through a user-friendly, watch-based map. 

The app's intuitive interface allows for easy navigation and tracking of your route, ensuring you never lose your way. After completing your workout, seamlessly upload your route data to Strava with just one click, making it easier than ever to track your progress and share your adventures with friends. 

FitCrumbs is more than just an app; it's a dependable tool for every journey, streamlining your route planning and tracking so you can concentrate on the adventure.

show_hn.title: Show HN: FitCrumbs – Outdoor workout companion for your Apple Watch

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I am an avid runner and I wanted to bring some of my favourite features (navigation and route building) to my go-to smart watch, the Apple Watch.

So far the app is focused around features that bring the most use for me in my day-to-day training: route creation; navigation on the watch (also offline, without the phone); easy upload to Strava

More features are in the working, I'm open to any ideas or feedback :)
